It issues guidelines for the State Legal Services Authorities to implement the legal programmes and schemes throughout the country /  पूरे देश में विधिक कार्यक्रमों व योजनाओं को कार्यान्वित करने के लिये यह राज्य विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरणों को दिशानिर्देश जारी करता है

solution:

A retired judge of the Supreme Court nominated by the President in consultation with the Chief Justice of India is its executive chairman.

question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence : 
You need to offer them a better deal.
options: They are in need of being offered a better deal by yourself.
They need to be offered a better deal by you.
A better deal is needed by them and you have to offer it.
The offering of a better deal has to be done by you for their need.
solution:
The given sentence is in the active voice. In sentences, where the subject does not work but is worked upon by someone, the passive voice is made following the below structures:
Active: Subject + Is/Are/Am/Was/Were/Has/Have/Had + To + Verb (Ist form) + Object.
Passive: Object + Is/Are/Am/Was/Were/Has/Have/Had + To + Be + Verb (3rd form) + By + Subject…
Note- here ‘need’ acts as the helping verb
So, with the help of the above structures, we can convert the sentence into passive voice: They need to be offered a better deal by you.

question:

solution:
हरियाणा के पहले भूजल गुणवत्ता मानचित्र को तैयार करने के लिए 10,500 से अधिक भूजल नमूनों का संग्रह एवं प्रयोगशाला परीक्षण किया गया। यह अध्ययन छह वर्षों तक चला और राज्य के सभी 22 जिलों को शामिल किया गया। इससे किसानों को क्षेत्रानुसार उपयुक्त फसल चयन, वैज्ञानिक सिंचाई, लवणता नियंत्रण तथा जल संसाधनों के सतत उपयोग में सहायता मिलेगी। यह Climate Resilient Agriculture और Precision Farming को भी बढ़ावा देता है।
Over 10,500 groundwater samples were collected and laboratory-tested to prepare Haryana's first groundwater quality map. The study spanned six years and covered all 22 districts of the state. It will assist farmers in region-specific crop selection, scientific irrigation, salinity control, and the sustainable use of water resources. It also promotes climate-resilient agriculture and precision farming.

question:
